tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractor Registration certificate Class 4 and above, PWD or KNNL empanallement or other Govt Department empanalled consultants
A description of the manner in which Consultants would plan to execute the assignment work plan time schedule in Form F-3 and approach or methodology proposed for carrying out the assignment

GSTThe contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST either materials or works contract (Service). GST payable by the Contractor under this works Contract will be paid to the Contractor separately over and above the Contractor s bid amount. The increase if any in the GST shall not be paid in the extended period of Contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the Authority.
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST. Hence GST will be paid separately.
The department and contractor are bounded for Excess payment/recovery in case of revision in GST Rates.
Copy of GST certificate to be furnished
The composition of the team of personnel which the Consultant would propose to provide and the tasks which would be assigned to each team member in Form F-4

Curicula Vitae of the individual key staff members to be assigned for the assignment and of the team leader who would be responsible for supervision of the team. The curricula Vita e should be in Form F-5and signed by the concerned personnel
Latest copy of the Income tax return filing acknowledgment mentioning the PAN No.
Details of Organization setup State whether proprietorship, partnership, private Limited or Public Limited.

The intending bidder has to visit the site and get familiar with site condition and discuss regarding scope of work to be done with concerned section officer, Assistant Engineer and Assistant Executive Engineer and get duly signed site inspection certificate by Executive Engineer in charge.
